subject.title: [Feature]: Clickable file links in chat with file viewer sidebar; workspace navigator previews any in-root file

question: Should Control UI/Gateway widen `sessions.files.get` from transcript-touched files to any fs-safe in-workspace file and add core chat file-link/file-viewer UI now?
rationale: The source-level problem is clear, but the requested fix deliberately changes visible chat UX and the gateway file-content read boundary under an existing operator read scope, and the issue is protected by the `maintainer` label.

options.title: Approve bounded in-root viewer
options.body: Keep the linked PR direction, require the current correctness fixes, and explicitly bless fs-safe in-root file reads under the existing preview cap.

options.title: Split UI from read scope
options.body: Land chat link handling and transcript-touched previews first, then review workspace-wide content preview as a narrower security/product decision.

options.title: Keep transcript-only previews
options.body: Preserve the current narrower read surface and leave browser-only files copy/browse-only until a different authorization or protocol shape exists.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded in-root viewer
recommendation.body: Keep the linked PR direction, require the current correctness fixes, and explicitly bless fs-safe in-root file reads under the existing preview cap.

likelyOwner.reason: They opened the protected request and authored the candidate implementation that changes the UX and read boundary.
